coverage: All six states, the Northern Territory, Australian Capital Territory and separate Jervis Bay Territory, plus all seven external territories. Full-resolution ABS 2025 LGA approximations, excluding non-spatial no-usual-address and migratory codes from the map, with unincorporated areas retained. Spatial local areas load per state. Macquarie Island remains part of Tasmania, not an invented territory. Antarctica is a labelled claim with Natural Earth coastline, not exclusive sovereignty.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

au-lga-2025.provider: Australian Bureau of Statistics · full-resolution ASGS LGA 2025

au-population-2025.provider: ABS · estimated resident population at 30 June 2025

overseas-coastlines.provider: OpenStreetMap · directed coastlines inside exact territory relations

macquarie-coastline.provider: OpenStreetMap · Macquarie Island, part of Tasmania

antarctic-land.provider: Natural Earth v5.1.2 · Antarctic land coastline (claim sectors are not exclusive sovereignty)
